meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: A Look Back: 1970 FIFA World Cup Mexico™, The Best of FIFA World Cup Spain 1982™, FACTS: Spain v England | Australia/New Zealand 2023, FC Internazionale Milano v Fluminense FC | Round of 16 | FIFA Club World Cup 2025™ | Full Match Replay, Chelsea FC v LAFC | Group D | FIFA Club World Cup 2025™ | Full Match Replay
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
